import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void run() {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int size = scanner.nextInt();
        List<Integer> numbers = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int val = scanner.nextInt();
            numbers.add(val);
        }
        Collections.sort(numbers);
        int left_pointer = -1, right_pointer = 0, max_count = 0, max_diff;
        max_diff = scanner.nextInt();
        while (right_pointer != size) {
            left_pointer++;
            while (right_pointer < size && numbers.get(right_pointer) - numbers.get(left_pointer) <= max_diff) {
                right_pointer++;
            }
            max_count = Math.max(max_count, right_pointer - left_pointer);
        }
        System.out.println(max_count);
        scanner.close();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        run();
    }
}
